title: TLS verification weakened (proxy) — review required
description: proxy weakens TLS verification: proxy_ssl_verifys+off. The connection then trusts attackers' certificates. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or restores verification.
remediation: Restore verification (proxy_ssl_verify on plus trusted CA).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of environment.
